name: War of Eleven
description: War waged by noble houses before they agreed to trade in peace.

description_citations.text: "Statuary Garden". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The War of Eleven ends when the nobles' court inventors open communication and end the conflict, founding Ghirapur and the first Consulate.
timeline.quote: The eleven artificers made the contested land their nation

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur is founded as neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities after the War of Eleven and grows to dominate its region.
timeline.quote: Ghirapur was founded in the aftermath of the War of Eleven as a neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities.

citation.text: "Ghirapur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eleven bridges are built over the Dukhara Canal to symbolize the noble houses of the War of Eleven setting aside their differences.
timeline.quote: spanned by eleven grand bridges built to symbolize the willingness of the noble houses who once waged the War of Eleven to set aside their differences
